---
title: "Component split-screen"
video:
  width: 640
  height: 360
  fps: 30
---

Four split-screen scenes. The first two clips show different source ranges of
the same counter clip, side by side. The others put text beside footage, put
three regions across the canvas, and use compatible animations.

::: {.scene component="split-screen" duration="2s"}
::: {.video src="assets/wide.mp4" region="left" fit="contain" sourceStart="1s" sourceEnd="3s" audio="mute" alt="A counter clip, left region, from 1 s"}
:::
::: {.video src="assets/wide.mp4" region="right" fit="contain" sourceStart="0s" sourceEnd="2s" audio="mute" alt="A counter clip, right region, from 0 s"}
:::
:::

::: {.scene component="split-screen" duration="3s"}
::: {.left}
Text in the left region, footage in the right.
:::
::: {.video src="assets/four-three.mp4" region="right" fit="cover" audio="mute" alt="A 4:3 counter clip in the right region"}
:::
:::

::: {.scene component="split-screen" duration="3s" animation="fade-in"}
::: {.left}
Three regions.
:::
::: {.video src="assets/tall.mp4" region="middle" fit="contain" loop="true" audio="mute" alt="A tall counter clip in the middle region"}
:::
::: {.right}
Each region is a column.
:::
:::

::: {.scene component="split-screen" duration="2s" animation="reveal"}
::: {.left}
Two regions of text.
:::
::: {.right}
Each one fits its own column.
:::
:::
